constraint.description: Return all Entities that are part of more than one Aggregate via their Transitive Closure.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (a:AggregateRoot) WITH a OPTIONAL MATCH p=shortestPath((a)-[:DEPENDS_ON*]->(e:Entity)) WHERE NOT e:AggregateRoot AND NONE(x IN tail(nodes(p)) WHERE (x:AggregateRoot)) WITH e, collect(DISTINCT a.name) AS aggregates WHERE size(aggregates) > 1 AND e IS NOT NULL RETURN e.fqn, aggregates AS Aggregates
